anchor_text: Kids Build safe structure, focus, and confidence after school. You get a clear first step, a calm room, and coaching tailored to brand-new students.
Teens Develop composure, skill, and steady progress without posturing. Teens receive coaching and movement in a room designed to help them settle in before intensity rises.
Adults Start smart, even if you feel out of shape or out of practice. Learn basic concepts and strategies in a room with no big egos. Build timing in the coached Beginner class.
Tannersville The home-base page. Walkable from Main Street.
Hunter A short Route 23A drive. Choose the right time during ski season.
Windham A 15–20 minute drive for a planned family routine.
Haines Falls Our closest mountain-town neighbor.
Palenville Up-the-mountain commitment for structured indoor training.
Catskill For families and adults who want small-group coaching.
Cairo A realistic weekly rhythm for committed families.
Woodstock A 25-minute scenic drive up Route 214 through Stony Clove Notch.

Leg Entanglement Leg entanglement is a lower-body control relationship where the legs are connected in a way that limits movement and creates attack or control options. Read more →

Knee Line Knee line is the position of the knee relative to a leg entanglement or lower-body control. Whether the knee is trapped, hidden, cleared, or exposed often changes how strong the control or escape is. Read more →
Control Control means limiting your partner’s movement enough to stay safe, improve position, or attack with more confidence. Read more →
Inside Position Inside position means winning the space between your partner's arms or legs so your connections are more direct, safer, and easier to build from. Read more →
X Guard X guard is an open-guard structure where the legs create lifting and steering control under a standing or mobile opponent. Read more →
